# 社区行为准则 / Code of Conduct

## 我们的承诺 / Our Pledge

为了营造开放、友善、包容的社区环境，我们作为贡献者和维护者承诺：无论年龄、种族、民族、性别认同与表达、性取向、残障、外貌、体型、经验水平、教育背景、社会经济状况、国籍或宗教信仰如何，都会以尊重的方式参与项目。

To foster an open, welcoming, and inclusive community, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, appearance, body size, experience level, education, socioeconomic status, nationality, or religion.

## 我们期望的行为 / Expected Behavior

- 尊重不同的观点、经验和选择。
- 以善意回应建设性的反馈，并专注于问题而非个人。
- 清楚、诚实地表达自己的观点；不确定时主动说明假设。
- 关注对社区和项目都有帮助的讨论。
- 尊重项目成员的隐私，不公开聊天记录、日志、API 密钥、个人信息或真实用户数据。

- Be respectful of differing viewpoints, experiences, and choices.
- Receive constructive feedback in good faith and focus on the issue, not the person.
- Communicate clearly and honestly, and state assumptions when uncertain.
- Keep discussions useful to the community and the project.
- Respect privacy. Do not publish chat transcripts, logs, API keys, personal information, or real user data.

## 不可接受的行为 / Unacceptable Behavior

- 骚扰、歧视、侮辱、威胁或人身攻击。
- 发布他人未经同意的私人信息，或试图识别、曝光匿名参与者。
- 发布恶意代码、恶意链接、凭据、真实用户数据或其他敏感信息。
- 有意破坏讨论、提交垃圾内容、冒充他人或滥用项目基础设施。
- 违反适用法律、项目许可或 GitHub 规则的行为。

- Harassment, discrimination, insults, threats, or personal attacks.
- Publishing private information without consent, or attempting to identify or expose anonymous participants.
- Publishing malicious code, malicious links, credentials, real user data, or other sensitive information.
- Deliberately disrupting discussions, spamming, impersonating others, or abusing project infrastructure.
- Conduct that violates applicable law, the project license, or GitHub policies.

## 维护者的责任 / Maintainer Responsibilities

维护者负责解释和执行本准则，并可删除不当内容、限制参与权限，或采取其认为必要的其他措施。维护者的决定应当以维护一个安全、可持续、专注于项目的社区为目标。

Maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing this Code of Conduct. They may remove inappropriate content, restrict participation, or take any other action they consider necessary. Decisions should aim to keep the community safe, sustainable, and focused on the project.

## 如何报告问题 / Reporting

请不要在公开 Issue 中报告骚扰、隐私泄露或其他敏感事件。请联系项目维护者：

- GitHub：通过项目主页联系维护者，或使用仓库提供的私密渠道。
- QQ：加入开发者 QQ 群 `263402786`，并私信或在群内联系 `Eternal-Wanderer-Vegetable`。

Please do not report harassment, privacy disclosures, or other sensitive incidents in a public issue. Contact the maintainer privately through the project’s GitHub channels or the developer QQ group `263402786` by contacting `Eternal-Wanderer-Vegetable`.

我们会尽可能尊重报告者的隐私，并根据事件严重程度和可核实信息采取适当行动。

We will respect the reporter’s privacy as far as possible and take appropriate action based on the severity of the incident and the available evidence.

## 适用范围 / Scope

本准则适用于项目仓库、Issue、Pull Request、讨论区、项目相关的公开或私下交流，以及代表本项目参与活动的其他场合。

This Code of Conduct applies within the project repository, Issues, Pull Requests, discussions, project-related public or private communications, and other settings where someone is representing the project.

## 归属 / Attribution

本文件参考 [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) 2.1 版，并结合 Stella 项目实际情况进行了补充。

This document is adapted from version 2.1 of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) and supplemented for the Stella project.
